t: A free Blender fork with a reworked interface made for artists.
steps: Download Bforartists from its official release page.
Pick the Windows, Apple Silicon Mac, or Linux build.
Ask IT to approve the install on lab computers.
Check the hardware. No Intel Mac or Chromebook build was seen.
Open the bundled models and rotate one in the viewport.
Save a custom workspace for a first lesson.
Walk through one small modeling task before class.
